desc: §8.1 max-activation structural floor (P6.1) + I-4 random-direction floor control

value.note: total floor basis-ROBUST (52.6% both); composition shifts (whitespace up 1.8->11.7%, numeric down 25.7->21.1%)

i4_random_floor.method: Identical all-docs top-20 decode+classify pipeline on the 171 emotion vectors vs 200 random directions (rand_directions_proj).
i4_random_floor.finding: random directions are MORE structurally-confounded (66-68%) than the emotion vectors (48-52%). The confound is a generic property of extreme projections on this corpus, AND the emotion vectors carry real concept signal ABOVE chance (content 52% vs random 34%).
